Title: Ajay and the Family

Cast

1. Ajay - 33 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sonali - 56 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Neeta - 29 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Anita - 30 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The office - Day

[Ajay stands in the office. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ajay clutches his chest, collapses with a heart attack and dies.]

Sonali: "No… this cannot be!"
